name: Python (uv)
description: Runs Python code from a submitted .py file or from the answer text, and compares what it prints with the key answer.
author: Red Pen

keyInput.label: Expected output
keyInput.help: What the program should print. Trailing blank lines and outer whitespace are ignored.

settings.label: Python version
settings.help: uv downloads this version on first use and keeps it in its cache.

settings.label: Packages
settings.help: One package per line, for example numpy or pandas==2.2. It is installed into the run environment automatically.

settings.label: Seconds before stopping
settings.help: How long the submitted program may run.
